eligibility_evidence: Job Responsibilities Conduct on-site coordination at US data centers; liaise with colo facilities, telecom carriers, hardware vendors, and the Shenzhen technical team.
Participate in on-call rotation for emergency outages, and perform on-site troubleshooting in datacenters as required.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Job Requirements Minimum 5 years of network operations experience, with exposure to data centers or GPU cluster networking. Proficient with BGP, OSPF, VLAN, ACL, VPN, firewalls, and Spine-Leaf architecture. Hands-on experience with Cisco, Arista, Juniper, or NVIDIA/Mellanox network hardware. English proficiency for daily communication with US datacenter staff and vendors; must hold valid legal work authorization in the United States.
